summary: Frontend testing for NewVehicle plate search and ComprehensiveFinancial net income card. Both features have critical issues: 1) NewVehicle search dropdown not appearing despite data being available via API (116 customers, 83 vehicles). 2) ComprehensiveFinancial showing all zeros for net income, cash/bank revenue, and account balances 1101/1102 despite API returning non-zero values (Net Income: 10,649.5 SAR, Cash 1101: 14,989 SAR, Bank 1102: 3,346 SAR).

ui_bugs.issue: Customer search dropdown not appearing when typing in search box. Tested with: '0', '0000', 'ابو خالد', '٠٠٠'. No dropdown appears despite API returning 116 customers and 83 vehicles.
Net income card showing all zeros. API returns: net_income=10,649.5, revenue=19,161, expenses=8,511.5. UI shows: 0 SAR for all values.
Cash/Bank revenue in subtitle showing zeros. API returns cash account 1101=14,989 SAR, bank account 1102=3,346 SAR. UI shows: 0 SAR for both.
Payment method breakdown (نقد/بنك/آجل) in expanded details showing all zeros despite API having data.
Account balances 1101 (النقد) and 1102 (البنك) showing zeros in expanded details. API shows 1101=14,989 SAR, 1102=3,346 SAR.

integration_issues.issue: Search input accepts text but dropdown with results never appears. customerDirectory and vehicleDirectory may not be loading into React state correctly.
API calls succeed (verified via curl) but data not rendering in UI. Possible issue with React Query data unwrapping or state management.

new_vehicle_plate_search_0000.details: Search '0000' - no dropdown appeared (customer 'ابو خالد الكبير' has plate '0000' in DB)

new_vehicle_arabic_digits_search.details: Could not test as dropdown never appears

financial_net_income_value.details: Shows 0 SAR, expected ~10,649.5 SAR from API

financial_cash_bank_revenue.details: Shows 0 SAR for both cash and bank revenue

financial_account_1101_balance.details: Shows 0 SAR, expected 14,989 SAR from API

financial_account_1102_balance.details: Shows 0 SAR, expected 3,346 SAR from API

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix NewVehicle customer search dropdown - data loads via API but dropdown never appears. Check customerDirectory/vehicleDirectory state loading and showCustomerResults condition.
CRITICAL: Fix ComprehensiveFinancial data display - API returns correct values but UI shows all zeros. Check React Query data unwrapping (unwrapApiData function) and state binding.
Verify workshopId is being passed correctly to finance API calls
Check if incomeStatementQuery.data and balanceSheetQuery.data are being populated correctly
critical_code_review_comments: NewVehicle.jsx: customerResults useMemo depends on customerSearchIndex and vehicleSearchIndex which depend on customerDirectory and vehicleDirectory. If these arrays are empty, no results will show.
NewVehicle.jsx: showCustomerResults condition at line 204-208 may be blocking dropdown display if customerResults.length is 0
ComprehensiveFinancial.jsx: incomeTotals defaults to {revenue:0, expenses:0, net_income:0} if incomeStatementQuery.data is null/undefined. Check if data is being unwrapped correctly.
ComprehensiveFinancial.jsx: salesSummary fallback at line 354-362 may be returning zeros if salesOperationsData is not loading
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both NewVehicle search and ComprehensiveFinancial have critical data display issues. APIs return correct data but UI shows zeros/no results. Previous iteration 151 reported search was working - this is a regression. Route for financial page is /accounting/comprehensive not /comprehensive-financial.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause appears to be React state not being populated with API data. For NewVehicle: customerDirectory and vehicleDirectory arrays may be empty despite API returning data. For ComprehensiveFinancial: incomeStatementQuery.data and balanceSheetQuery.data may not be unwrapping correctly. Both issues suggest a data flow problem between API response and React state.
